propositions: tolerant_parse() returns the first parseable JSON object in model replies, allowing quoted tool results or examples to override the intended payload
repeated historical fixes (git 9007f290, 5ed760a1, 1aa90fa5) are re-broken by routine model provider changes such as the Bedrock cutover
schema-filtered candidate selection with last-valid-wins logic in parse_structured() must disambiguate multiple valid JSON objects in a single reply
prompted structured-output replies require an explicit sentinel output channel directive whose extraction ships atomically to prevent schema-valid decoys from matching first
provider-native structured output (Bedrock outputConfig) must be gated on measured thinking-compatibility per model rather than blanket-forced across all models
measured provider capability matrix data must inform which models use native structured output versus the hardened prompted fallback path
